docs.text:

docs.title: About this site
docs.text: code.fontlab.com is the GitHub Pages site of the fontlabcom organization. Project sites in the organization that have no domain of their own appear under it, for example code.fontlab.com/getgo-fonts/.

docs.title: How it is built
docs.text:
The source lives in fontlabcom/fontlabcom.github.io. ProperDocs and the MaterialX theme build the Markdown in src_docs/md/ into docs/, which GitHub Pages publishes. The FontLab theme 2026 supplies the global menu, footer, colours and components.

To change a page, edit its Markdown file, then run:

./build.sh

Commit both src_docs/ and the rebuilt docs/.

docs.title: Add a project
docs.text: Add a section to src_docs/md/projects.md. List only public repositories.
